understanding.intended_outcome: The new supplier specified in Procurement's onboarding request is created and approved in the Acme ERP vendor master with all required onboarding details.
success_criteria: A vendor record exists in the Acme ERP Vendor master with legal name matching '<legal name from Procurement request>'.
The vendor record contains the correct GSTIN and AP contact email as provided in the request.
The vendor record reflects the agreed payment terms (or Net 30 if unspecified).
Approval for creating the new vendor has been secured prior to finalizing vendor creation.
plan: Locate and inspect the forwarded onboarding email from Procurement in 'company_drive/inbox/'.
Extract the required onboarding details: legal name, GSTIN, AP contact email, and payment terms (default to Net 30 if omitted).
Log into Acme ERP at 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/erp' using agent credentials.
Check the Vendor master to confirm the supplier does not already exist.
Request or verify manager approval for creating the new vendor in accordance with company policy.
Enter and submit the new vendor details in Acme ERP Vendor master.
Verify that the new vendor record appears accurately in the ERP vendor list.
relevant_policies: Vendor onboarding: Only onboard a vendor when Procurement has sent an onboarding request (see inbox/).
Vendor onboarding: Required: legal name (exactly as in the request), GSTIN, AP contact email, payment terms.
Vendor onboarding: Payment terms: use the terms stated in the signed contract/request. If none are stated, default to Net 30.
Approval policy: Creating a new vendor always requires approval.
risks: Creating a new vendor requires manager approval; proceeding without approval violates company policy.
The email in inbox/ might lack essential fields (e.g., missing GSTIN or AP contact email), requiring clarification with Procurement.
The vendor may already exist under a slightly different name or existing GSTIN, risking duplicate master data.
